symptom: The revenue dashboard is showing zero for last week. It was fine at yesterday's close; it broke overnight. Finance noticed before we did.
conclusion:
# Morning report — revenue dashboard zeroed overnight

**Started from memory.** This is the **third occurrence** of a known break (prior incidents c9f3ffe7, 941adb6a). No lineage re-walked — verified the remembered cause in exactly the two reads the postmortem prescribed. Root cause in ~3 minutes.

**Root cause (single, verified):** Upstream Snowflake `order_entry_db.order_entry.orders` renamed `order_total` → `order_amount`. The **deployed** dbt `order_details` model still selects `o.order_total` → NULLs → `SUMX(order_total)` in the PowerBI `Essential_KPI_Measures` sums to zero. Both reads confirm: the orders schema has only `order_amount` (description literally says "renamed from order_total"), and the deployed model logic still says `o.order_total`.

**Fix:** In dbt `order_details`, change `o.order_total` → `o.order_amount AS order_total`, rebuild, backfill last week's window.

**The real problem is process, not SQL:** this exact alias fix was issued on two prior nights and never stuck in prod — the upstream refactor branch keeps shipping without it. Escalated to the model owner (michael2@example.com / Data Platform Team) to land it permanently and add a dbt source test so CI blocks any build referencing `order_total` at the source.

**Closed the loop:** incident opened and resolved (`045d5439`), postmortem written to memory with a next-night shortcut (1 read: check deployed SQL, then chase the merge), and a new guard on `order_details.order_total` (`nightshift-9e2ce465...`) asserting non-null/non-zero after every build — on top of the two guards from last time.
